name: foundry-connect
description: Run the Foundry Connect pipeline lifecycle from Claude: explore runs, access and analyze results, share them back, author processes, build or extend pipelines, launch runs and apps, and answer questions from a project knowledge base. Includes the foundry-pipelines, foundry-pipeline-dev and foundry-kb skills and the /foundry-* commands. Connect your own Foundry Connect instance as an MCP connector first, as the README describes.
